newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Datacraft plans to raise US$30-50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Datacraft plans to raise US$30-50 mln.

text.p: Datacraft Asia Ltd said on Monday it was looking to raise funds of US$30-50 million by the end of 1997.
"We are looking at US$30-50 million," Ron Cattell, Datacraft's executive director told Reuters after a briefing on the group's 1996/1997 results.
Des Althorp, Datacraft's chief executive officer and managing director said at the news conference that the exercise would take place by the end of this year.
"We think equity may be the most attractive for us. Our (management's) preference is to issue new shares because liquity for Datacraft shares is quite tight," Althorp said.
The capital raised woould be used to help finance two acquisitions previously made in Philippines and New Zealand and for working capital, Althorp said.
